parsed.title: Occurrence of Antibodies Cross-reacting With Autoantigens in Primary EBV Infection
parsed.target_population: Adults (≥18 years) presenting with either a primary Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) infection (infectious mononucleosis group) or an upper respiratory tract infection/confirmed primary CMV infection (control group), without immunosuppression or history of autoimmune disease.
parsed.intervention_summary: Observational study involving collection of clinical data, blood samples (EBV serology, autoantibody testing/biobanking, RNA expression, procalcitonin) and patient-reported fatigue questionnaires; no therapeutic intervention.

rules.text: Informed consent as documented by signature
Confirmed primary EBV infection as confirmed by the treating clinician

Compatible clinical picture: infectious mononucleosis symptoms including but not limited to malaise, headache, fever, tonsillitis, pharyngitis, cervical lymph nodes enlargement (not all features required)
Compatible laboratory picture: lymphocyte count elevation, LUC cells, reactive lymphocytes in manual differential, elevated liver enzymes (not all features required)
Serology compatible with primary EBV infection: anti-EBNA IgG negative, anti-VCA IgG negative, anti-VCA IgM positive OR anti-EBNA IgG negative, anti-VCA IgG positive, anti-VCA IgM positive

One of the following: (1) Clinical picture of upper respiratory tract infection (including but not limited to tonsillitis/pharyngitis, malaise, headache, cough, rhinitis, cervical node enlargement) OR (2) confirmed primary Cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection
Suspicion/diagnosis of IM as per judgement of the treating clinician (control group only); such individual may be eligible later for the IM group if primary EBV infection is confirmed subsequently
Immunosuppression (broadly defined as primary/secondary immunodeficiency or treatment with an immunosuppressive medication including ≥ 10mg prednisone equivalent)
History of autoimmune disease (e.g. SLE, vasculitis etc.)

parsed.parsing_notes: 시험은 IM 그룹과 대조군(control group)으로 나뉘며 일부 기준이 그룹별로 다름. 동의서(I1), 연령(I2), 성별(I3) 기준은 두 그룹 모두에 공통 적용. IM 그룹의 진단 기준(I4~I7)은 임상적 증상, 검사 소견, 혈청학 조건이 복합적으로 결합되어 있어 단일 구조화 필드로 환원하기 어려움(특히 혈청학 조건은 OR로 묶인 다중 항목). 대조군 포함 기준(I8)도 OR 조건으로 단일 규칙 처리함. 제외 기준 중 면역억제 정의는 구체적 약물 용량 기준(prednisone ≥10mg equivalent)이 있으나 표준화된 lab/medication 필드로 환원하기 어려워 structured_evaluable=false로 처리함. 자가면역질환 및 IM 의심 제외 기준은 구체적 예시가 있어 underspecified=false로 판단함.

I1: 절차 선정 기준 (미확인이어도 적격을 막지 않음)
